summary:
默沙東EPS超預期1.5%，季度營收逾164億美元顯示核心藥物組合動能穩健。
• EPS 2.04美元，超出預期2.01美元，超預期幅度1.47%
• 營收164.0億美元，反映核心藥物組合貢獻穩定
• Keytruda等旗艦藥物維持成長動能
• 獲利穩健達標，現金流支撑股息與研發投資
ai_view:
訊號穩健：EPS溫和超預期，季度營收逾164億美元，顯示核心藥物組合（以Keytruda為首）動能穩健。短期股價中性偏多，營收年增率未揭露使成長判讀有限。中期最大課題仍是Keytruda專利懸崖前的管線接棒與多元化。追蹤指標：Keytruda營收占比、新藥與併購進展、調整後獲利、毛利率、研發產出與全年指引。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，成長動能須結合趨勢判讀；Keytruda專利懸崖逼近的長期營收集中風險；藥價政策與管線研發成敗的不確定性

summary_en:
Merck beat EPS by 1.5% with $16.4B revenue, showing steady momentum in its core drug portfolio.
• EPS of $2.04 beat the $2.01 estimate by 1.47%
• Revenue of $16.40B reflects steady contribution from the core drug portfolio
• Keytruda and other flagship drugs maintain growth momentum
• Steady earnings delivery, with cash flow backing dividends and R&D

ai_view_en:
Signal is steady: a modest EPS beat with $16.4B revenue shows steady momentum in the core portfolio led by Keytruda. Near-term neutral-to-positive, with undisclosed YoY limiting growth reads. Mid-term the biggest issue remains pipeline succession and diversification ahead of Keytruda's patent cliff. Track: Keytruda revenue mix, new-drug and M&A progress, adjusted earnings, gross margin, R&D output and full-year guidance.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, so momentum must be read against the trend; Long-term revenue-concentration risk as Keytruda's patent cliff approaches; Uncertainty from drug-pricing policy and pipeline R&D outcomes
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS超預期1.47%屬溫和達標（營收年增率未揭露）。
